title: Make GLOBAL installation idempotent
body: Make the installed GLOBAL KRN skill list empty, add reinstall-idempotence coverage proving disabled hooks stay disabled, and make rollback compare current values with installer-written values before restoring. Acceptance: repeated installs produce no changes, disabled hooks remain disabled, and rollback preserves intervening edits.
